d: Gautam Adani, India’s second-richest man and chairman of the Adani Group, has revealed his four potential successors in a Fortune India interview. The 64-year-old industrialist named his sons Karan Adani and Jeet Adani along with nephews Pranav Adani and Sagar Adani as the next generation who may lead the conglomerate. Karan Adani, Managing Director of Adani Ports and SEZ, oversees ports, logistics, transportation and the group’s cement business after major acquisitions. Jeet Adani focuses on airports through Adani Airport Holdings, plus futuristic verticals including AI, data centres,…
